what: Buyer purchased wall art on Etsy with 14-day return window; product quality was poor and did not match listing photos; upon initiating return, discovered seller was located in Turkey; UPS quoted return shipping cost over $1,100; buyer was unaware of seller's country before purchase.
verbatim_snippet: "I purchased a piece of wall art on Etsy that stated a 14 day return window so I felt it was safe to order the product. Upon opening the product, I immediately knew it was poor quality and did not appear as the Etsy photo. I immediately placed it back in the box and contacted the seller for return. After a few correspondence and her trying to talk me into keeping it, I stood firm and reminded her of the return policy as stated on the website. She then gave me her return address. It was in the county of Turkey, I was not aware if this prior to purchase or I would have never bought it. I took it up to UPS to get a price to send it back and it was over $1100.00."
notes: ConsumerAffairs page returned 403 error on direct fetch; verbatim captured from search engine index. Reviewer anonymous. Product type: wall art. Return shipping cost: >$1,100 (to Turkey). Buyer decision factor: return policy as trust signal. Discovery of seller location only upon return.
